correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the analytic proof for all integers t≥2,d>2t. The exact score mismatch identity (1) follows by expanding squared norms and double-counting Nc; Kneser eigenvalues via incidence filtration and its nontrivial absolute spectral gap θ=c(d−2t)/(d−t) yield vector Poincaré (2). Shared translation covariance yields identical sphere/input deviation h² and exact completeness errors. Every t-layer vertex shares a radius-t sphere with a distinct (t−2)-layer vertex, so approximate orthogonality/completeness gives h²≥1/(256k³). The combination yields the claimed absolute and relative gaps for every finite-dimensional strategy. Independently performed 343 finite diagnostic checks of spectra, sphere geometry, and score identities; the infinite conclusion relies on the symbolic argument. The comparison ratio to older Oct12 quantitative bound exceeds 1 uniformly, minimum at d=5,t=2.

This is a substantive quantitative all-parameter improvement, not a mere rephrasing of strict inequality or a finite sample. Constants may not be sharp.
